criteria.requirement: Repair Tree.from_map as one complete import operation: validate exactly one root, all parent references and complete reachability including detached cycles/self-cycles before conversion callbacks or building nodes. Reject invalid input with useful involved IDs, never silently discard records. Accept valid out-of-order maps, preserve sibling insertion order, call id_func once per record and reject None/unhashable/colliding transformed IDs. Honor cls and explicitly forwarded **tree_kwargs, including custom node_class and constructor failures, without guessing required arguments or swallowing them. Data callbacks build a fresh tree; old legal behavior remains compatible.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
